rheumatoid_arthritis.stratum: systemic immune-mediated inflammatory disease; multiple intervention mechanisms and human/preclinical evidence

parkinsons_disease.stratum: central nervous system degeneration; symptomatic effects and disease-course effects require separation

cystic_fibrosis.stratum: inherited loss-of-function disease; eligibility and intervention direction may depend on genotype

pancreatic_ductal_adenocarcinoma.stratum: solid tumor; disease subtype, cell-intrinsic and microenvironment evidence may differ

initial_state: New copies without prior decisions, selected targets, source lists, candidates or answer keys
public_sources: Registered product source adapters, same availability to both arms; successful bundles separately counted
response_cap_unit: External subscription invocations; internal CLI messages/Read actions are not additional external responses and are separately recorded
masking: Procedure labels removed from content review pages until frozen aggregation; same preparer reviewed, so not independent or fully blinded
